Mind the Gap: Keeping Export Compliance Within Reach as BIS Focuses on Enforcement
news.summary_en: The Department of Commerce is emphasizing enforcement of export controls and engaging less with industry. CSIS and UGA experts lay out four steps to keep the resulting compliance burden manageable.

news.title: Contested Skies: What a Recent Military Operation with Mexico Reveals About the Homeland Drone Fight
news.summary_en: A novel operation along the southwest border to counter cartel drones demonstrated homeland drone defense that centers the U.S. military in a law enforcement role. This analysis examines Operation High Eagle and its implications for U.S. ability to defend against drones.

news.title: Trilateral “Denuclearization”: False Promises or Way Forward?
news.summary_en: The Trump administration wants denuclearization on the agenda for potential talks with Putin and Xi at APEC. Washington should use the talks to lay the groundwork for trilateral arms control, promote transparency, and out-compete Beijing and Moscow in nuclear diplomacy.
